By swapping out silicon for GaN, Anker fits 30W of power into a charger that is just 1.12 inches thick and 70% smaller than an original 30W charger.
Upgraded with a 30W output, it charges your earbuds, phone, tablet and even your MacBook from one tiny charger.
Delivers full-speed 30W charging for iPhone 15/14 Pro and Pro Max, or powers up your iPad Air (5th generation) to 50% in just 45 minutes. Also supports Samsung Super Fast Charging (25W).
Anker's proprietary technology safeguards your devices by intelligently monitoring temperature over 3 million times per day, twice as often as ActiveShield 1.0.
Anker 511 Charger (Nano 3, 30W), user manual and a 12-month warranty. Cable not included.
